passages.text: This is the burden against Egypt: Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud; He is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble before Him, and the hearts of the Egyptians will melt within them.
passages.sermon:
This message is about Egypt.
The LORD is the God of Hosts.
The LORD rides on a fast cloud.
The LORD comes to Egypt.
The idols in Egypt shake before the LORD.
The hearts of the Egyptians melt inside them.
passages.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה רֹכֵ֨ב עַל־ עָ֥ב קַל֙ וּבָ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנָע֞וּ אֱלִילֵ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וּלְבַ֥ב מִצְרַ֖יִם יִמַּ֥ס בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “So I will incite Egyptian against Egyptian; brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt.
God says, “I will cause Egyptians to turn against each other.
Each brother will fight his own brother.
Each neighbor will fight his own neighbor.
One city will fight another city.
One kingdom will fight another kingdom.”
passages.original: וְסִכְסַכְתִּ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אִישׁ־ בְּאָחִ֖יו וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ עִ֣יר בְּעִ֔יר מַמְלָכָ֖ה בְּמַמְלָכָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord of Hosts.
God will act against Egypt.
God will remove the spirit from within the Egyptians.
God will frustrate the plans of the Egyptians.
The Egyptians will turn to idols.
The Egyptians will seek advice from the dead.
The Egyptians will consult mediums.
The Egyptians will ask spiritists for guidance.
passages.original: וְנָבְקָ֤ה רֽוּחַ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲצָת֖וֹ אֲבַלֵּ֑עַ וְדָרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־ הָֽאֱלִילִים֙ וְאֶל־ הָ֣אִטִּ֔ים וְאֶל־ הָאֹב֖וֹת וְאֶל־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: I will deliver the Egyptians into the hands of harsh masters, and a fierce king will rule over them,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD of Hosts speaks.
He will act against Egypt.
He will give the Egyptians into the hands of harsh masters.
A fierce king will rule over the Egyptians.
passages.original: וְסִכַּרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּיַ֖ד אֲדֹנִ֣ים קָשֶׁ֑ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ עַז֙ יִמְשָׁל־ בָּ֔ם נְאֻ֥ם הָאָד֖וֹן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The waters of the Nile will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and empty.
passages.sermon: God will dry up the waters of the Nile.\r\nThe riverbed will become parched.\r\nThe riverbed will be empty.
passages.original: וְנִשְּׁתוּ־ מַ֖יִם מֵֽהַיָּ֑ם וְנָהָ֖ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will trickle and dry up; the reeds and rushes will wither.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking about Egypt.
God will judge Egypt.
The canals in Egypt will stink.
The streams in Egypt will become weak.
The streams will dry up.
The reeds will wither.
The rushes will wither.
passages.original: וְהֶאֶזְנִ֣יחוּ נְהָר֔וֹת דָּלֲל֥וּ וְחָרְב֖וּ יְאֹרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר קָנֶ֥ה וָס֖וּף קָמֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: The bulrushes by the Nile, by the mouth of the river, and all the fields sown along the Nile, will wither, blow away, and be no more.
passages.sermon:
The bulrushes grow by the Nile.
They stand at the mouth of the river.
All the fields along the Nile are sown with crops.
The bulrushes will wither.
The fields will dry up.
The plants will blow away.
They will disappear completely.
passages.original: עָר֥וֹת עַל־ יְא֖וֹר עַל־ פִּ֣י יְא֑וֹר וְכֹל֙ מִזְרַ֣ע יְא֔וֹר יִיבַ֥שׁ נִדַּ֖ף וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Then the fishermen will mourn, all who cast a hook into the Nile will lament, and those who spread nets on the waters will pine away.
passages.sermon: The fishermen will mourn.\r\nAll who cast a hook into the Nile will lament.\r\nThose who spread nets on the waters will pine away.
passages.original: וְאָנוּ֙ הַדַּיָּגִ֔ים וְאָ֣בְל֔וּ כָּל־ מַשְׁלִיכֵ֥י בַיְא֖וֹר חַכָּ֑ה וּפֹרְשֵׂ֥י מִכְמֹ֛רֶת עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַ֖יִם אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: The workers in flax will be dismayed, and the weavers of fine linen will turn pale.
passages.sermon: The workers in flax will feel shame.\r\nThe weavers of fine linen will become pale.
passages.original: וּבֹ֛שׁוּ עֹבְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׂרִיק֑וֹת וְאֹרְגִ֖ים חוֹרָֽי׃

passages.text: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the hired workers will be sick at heart.
passages.sermon: The workers who make cloth will feel crushed.\r\nAll the hired workers will lose heart.\r\nThey will feel deep sadness.
passages.original: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁתֹתֶ֖יהָ מְדֻכָּאִ֑ים כָּל־ עֹ֥שֵׂי שֶׂ֖כֶר אַגְמֵי־ נָֽפֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The princes of Zoan are mere fools; Pharaoh’s wise counselors give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise, a son of eastern kings”?
passages.sermon:
The princes of Zoan are fools.
Pharaoh’s counselors are supposed to be wise.
But they give foolish advice.
They do not have true wisdom.
You say to Pharaoh, “I am wise.”
You claim, “I am a son of ancient kings.”
But your words are empty.
Your advice has no understanding.
passages.original: אַךְ־ אֱוִלִים֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן חַכְמֵי֙ יֹעֲצֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה עֵצָ֖ה נִבְעָרָ֑ה אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה בֶּן־ חֲכָמִ֥ים אֲנִ֖י בֶּן־ מַלְכֵי־ קֶֽדֶם׃

passages.text: Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and reveal what the LORD of Hosts has planned against Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Egypt is the subject.
Egypt has wise men.
Where are your wise men now?
Let your wise men come forward.
Let them tell you what will happen.
Let them reveal what the LORD of Hosts has planned against Egypt.
passages.original: אַיָּם֙ אֵפ֣וֹא חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְיַגִּ֥ידוּ נָ֖א לָ֑ךְ וְיֵ֣דְע֔וּ מַה־ יָּעַ֛ץ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deceived. The cornerstones of her tribes have led Egypt astray.
passages.sermon: The princes of Zoan have become fools.\r\nThe princes of Memphis are deceived.\r\nThe leaders of Egypt’s tribes have led Egypt astray.
passages.original: נֽוֹאֲלוּ֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן נִשְּׁא֖וּ שָׂ֣רֵי נֹ֑ף הִתְע֥וּ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם פִּנַּ֥ת שְׁבָטֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has great power.
The LORD poured a spirit of confusion into Egypt.
Egypt became confused.
Egypt went astray in everything she did.
Egypt could not find the right way.
Egypt was like a drunk person.
A drunk person staggers in his own vomit.
Egypt stumbled and fell in all her actions.
passages.original: יְהוָ֛ה מָסַ֥ךְ בְּקִרְבָּ֖הּ ר֣וּחַ עִוְעִ֑ים וְהִתְע֤וּ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּכָֽל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ כְּהִתָּע֥וֹת שִׁכּ֖וֹר בְּקִיאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm or reed.
passages.sermon:
Egypt is powerless.
Egypt cannot act.
No one in Egypt can do anything.
The leaders cannot act.
The lowest people cannot act.
The strong cannot act.
The weak cannot act.
No part of Egypt can do anything.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמִצְרַ֖יִם מַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה רֹ֥אשׁ וְזָנָ֖ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְאַגְמֽוֹן׃ס

passages.text: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the LORD of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is powerful.
He will lift His hand against Egypt.
On that day, the Egyptians will be afraid.
They will tremble with fear.
They will be like women.
They will fear the LORD’s raised hand.
The LORD will brandish His hand against them.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִֽהְיֶ֥ה מִצְרַ֖יִם כַּנָּשִׁ֑ים וְחָרַ֣ד׀ וּפָחַ֗ד מִפְּנֵי֙ תְּנוּפַת֙ יַד־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ ה֖וּא מֵנִ֥יף עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: The land of Judah will bring terror to Egypt; whenever Judah is mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the LORD of Hosts has planned against it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God has great power.
God makes plans against Egypt.
The land of Judah will frighten Egypt.
Whenever someone mentions Judah to Egypt, Egypt will feel fear.
Egypt will tremble because of what God has planned against it.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיְתָה אַדְמַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה לְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְחָגָּ֔א כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַזְכִּ֥יר אֹתָ֛הּ אֵלָ֖יו יִפְחָ֑ד מִפְּנֵ֗י עֲצַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ ה֖וּא יוֹעֵ֥ץ עָלָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
passages.sermon:
In that day, five cities will exist in the land of Egypt.
These cities will speak the language of Canaan.
These cities will swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts.
People will call one of these cities the City of the Sun.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יִהְיוּ֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם מְדַבְּרוֹת֙ שְׂפַ֣ת כְּנַ֔עַן וְנִשְׁבָּע֖וֹת לַיהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עִ֣יר הַהֶ֔רֶס יֵאָמֵ֖ר לְאֶחָֽת׃ס

passages.text: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD near her border.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God will act in Egypt.
On that day, Egypt will change.
There will be an altar to the LORD.
The altar will stand in the center of Egypt.
There will also be a pillar to the LORD.
The pillar will stand near Egypt’s border.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֤ה מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּמַצֵּבָ֥ה אֵֽצֶל־ גְּבוּלָ֖הּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of Hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God will give a sign in the land of Egypt.
God will give a witness in Egypt.
The people in Egypt will suffer under oppressors.
The people in Egypt will cry out to God for help.
God will hear their cry.
God will send a savior to Egypt.
God will send a defender to Egypt.
The savior and defender will rescue the people in Egypt.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לְא֥וֹת וּלְעֵ֛ד לַֽיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ יִצְעֲק֤וּ אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י לֹֽחֲצִ֔ים וְיִשְׁלַ֥ח לָהֶ֛ם מוֹשִׁ֥יעַ וָרָ֖ב וְהִצִּילָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and fulfill them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will reveal Himself to Egypt.
Egypt will know the LORD on that day.
The people of Egypt will worship the LORD.
They will bring sacrifices to the LORD.
They will bring offerings to the LORD.
They will make vows to the LORD.
They will keep their vows to the LORD.
passages.original: וְנוֹדַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְעָֽבְדוּ֙ זֶ֣בַח וּמִנְחָ֔ה וְנָדְרוּ־ נֵ֥דֶר לַֽיהוָ֖ה וְשִׁלֵּֽמוּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD will strike Egypt with a plague; He will strike them but heal them. They will turn to the LORD, and He will hear their prayers and heal them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Hosts.
The LORD will strike Egypt with a plague.
He will strike Egypt.
He will also heal Egypt.
The people of Egypt will turn to the LORD.
The LORD will hear their prayers.
The LORD will heal them.
passages.original: וְנָגַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם נָגֹ֣ף וְרָפ֑וֹא וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ עַד־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנֶעְתַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם וּרְפָאָֽם׃

passages.text: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will act on a special day.
On that day, God will make a highway.
This highway will go from Egypt to Assyria.
Assyria is a powerful nation.
Egypt is a powerful nation.
Assyrians will travel to Egypt.
Egyptians will travel to Assyria.
Egyptians and Assyrians will worship God together.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא תִּהְיֶ֨ה מְסִלָּ֤ה מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָה וּבָֽא־ אַשּׁ֥וּר בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִצְרַ֣יִם בְּאַשּׁ֑וּר וְעָבְד֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם אֶת־ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ס

passages.text: In that day Israel will join a three-party alliance with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing upon the earth.
passages.sermon:
Israel is a nation chosen by God.
Egypt and Assyria are two other great nations.
God will act on a special day.
On that day, Israel will join Egypt and Assyria.
These three nations will form a group together.
This group will be a blessing.
The blessing will be in the middle of the earth.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלִ֣ישִׁיָּ֔ה לְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְאַשּׁ֑וּר בְּרָכָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts will bless these nations.
The LORD will say these words.
Egypt is My people.
Assyria is the work of My hands.
Israel is My inheritance.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרֲכ֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּר֨וּךְ עַמִּ֜י מִצְרַ֗יִם וּמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדַי֙ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְנַחֲלָתִ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
